_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/casting/test_graveyard_additional_cost.py. t_gac_robot is a 2/2 creature castable from its owner's graveyard by discarding any card in addition to its printed {2}{U} -- Dragon Man, Reformed Robot's permission on a vanilla body. t_gac_brute is Helbrute's Sarcophagus on a vanilla 2/2: castable from the graveyard by exiling another creature card from it.

cards.name: Test Graveyard Robot
